## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Native select to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** Native select imports another component. Install them first, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Each doc lists its files; the download script below covers them too.
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this and the step before in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/native-select.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { NativeSelect } from '@/ui/components/native-select';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: Native select

The browser's own `<select>`, styled to match Input, with a chevron. All native behaviour is kept (mobile pickers, type-ahead, forms, autofill).

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-select-wrap [ui-select-wrap-sm|ui-select-wrap-lg]">
  <select class="ui-select">  <option value="">Placeholder</option> <optgroup/>… </select>
  <svg class="ui-select-icon" />      chevron-down, decorative
</div>
```

#### Props
- `size`: `sm` 32px · `md` 36px (default) · `lg` 44px. `wrapperClassName`. All native select props; `ref` goes to the `<select>`, `className` too.
- Inside a Field it takes id, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `required`, `disabled` via `useFieldControl` (from `../field/field-context`).

#### Visual rules
- Variables on the wrapper: `--ui-select-h` 2.25rem (sm 2rem, lg 2.75rem), `--ui-select-fs` 14px (13 / 15), `--ui-select-px` .75rem (.625 / 1rem), `--ui-select-r`.
- Select: `appearance: none`, 1px `--ui-border-strong`, bg `--ui-background` (dark: `--ui-foreground` 5% mix), `--ui-shadow-xs` (none in dark), padding-inline-end `--ui-select-px + 1.5rem` for the chevron, pointer cursor, ellipsis for long text.
- Options and optgroups: `--ui-surface-raised` bg and foreground (dark lists stay dark).
- A selected option with `value=""` reads as placeholder (`--ui-muted-foreground`, via `:has(> option[value=""]:checked)`).
- Chevron: 16px, absolutely centred at inline-end, `--ui-muted-foreground`, `pointer-events: none`; goes to `--ui-foreground` on hover (fine pointer) and focus.
- Hover (fine pointer), focus (border `--ui-ring` + 3px 25% ring), invalid (destructive border), disabled (.5, not-allowed) as Input.
- `multiple` or `size > 1` is a list box: auto height, no chevron.
- Touch: font-size 16px.

#### Motion
- Border, ring, background and chevron colour transition 150ms `--ui-ease-standard`.

#### Accessibility
- Native select semantics. Needs a label (Field + Label, or `aria-label`).

#### Acceptance checks
- Heights 32 / 36 / 44px; the chevron never blocks clicks.
- Changing the option updates the value; the placeholder option reads muted.
- Works inside a Field; no axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/native-select/native-select.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type SelectHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';

export interface NativeSelectProps extends Omit<SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>, 'size'> {
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  /** Class for the wrapper that holds the select and the chevron (width, margins). */
  wrapperClassName?: string;
}

/**
 * NativeSelect — the browser's own <select>, styled to match Input, with a
 * chevron. Keeps native behaviour: mobile pickers, type-ahead and form
 * participation. Inside a <Field> it picks up id, aria and required state.
 * An empty-value first option reads as a placeholder.
 */
export const NativeSelect = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, NativeSelectProps>(function NativeSelect(
  { size = 'md', wrapperClassName, className, id, required, disabled, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const control = useFieldControl({
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    'aria-describedby': props['aria-describedby'],
    'aria-invalid': props['aria-invalid'],
  });
  return (
    <div className={cn('ui-select-wrap', size !== 'md' && `ui-select-wrap-${size}`, wrapperClassName)}>
      <select ref={ref} className={cn('ui-select', className)} {...props} {...control}>
        {children}
      </select>
      <Icon name="chevron-down" className="ui-select-icon" />
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/native-select.css`

```css
/* Native select -----------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-select-wrap [ui-select-wrap-sm|lg]">
     <select class="ui-select">…</select>
     <svg class="ui-select-icon">chevron</svg>
   </div>
   Sizes live on the wrapper (variables), the select reads them.
   States: :hover, :focus, [aria-invalid], :disabled; an empty-value first
   option that is selected reads as a placeholder.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-select-wrap {
    --ui-select-h: 2.25rem;
    --ui-select-fs: var(--text-base);
    --ui-select-px: 0.75rem;
    --ui-select-r: var(--radius-md);
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .ui-select-wrap-sm { --ui-select-h: 2rem; --ui-select-fs: var(--text-sm); --ui-select-px: 0.625rem; }
  .ui-select-wrap-lg { --ui-select-h: 2.75rem; --ui-select-fs: var(--text-md); --ui-select-px: 1rem; --ui-select-r: var(--radius-lg); }

  .ui-select {
    --ui-select-bg: var(--ui-background);
    --ui-select-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: var(--ui-select-h);
    padding-inline: var(--ui-select-px) calc(var(--ui-select-px) + 1.5rem);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-select-border);
    border-radius: var(--ui-select-r);
    background-color: var(--ui-select-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--ui-select-fs);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    outline: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-select {
    --ui-select-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 5%, transparent);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-select option,
  .ui-select optgroup { background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised); color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground); }

  /* An empty-value option that is selected is the placeholder */
  .ui-select:has(> option[value=""]:checked) { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-select:hover:not(:focus, :disabled, [aria-invalid="true"]) {
      --ui-select-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 55%, var(--ui-foreground));
    }
  }
  .ui-select:focus {
    --ui-select-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-select[aria-invalid="true"] { --ui-select-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-select[aria-invalid="true"]:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent); }
  .ui-select:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* Chevron: decorative, the select receives every click */
  .ui-select-icon {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    inset-inline-end: var(--ui-select-px);
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    margin-top: -0.5rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-select-wrap:has(.ui-select:focus) .ui-select-icon { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-select-wrap:has(.ui-select:disabled) .ui-select-icon { opacity: 0.5; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-select-wrap:has(.ui-select:hover:not(:disabled)) .ui-select-icon { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }

  /* A list box (multiple / size > 1) has no chevron and sizes to its rows */
  .ui-select[multiple],
  .ui-select[size]:not([size="0"], [size="1"]) { height: auto; padding-block: 0.25rem; padding-inline-end: var(--ui-select-px); }
  .ui-select-wrap:has(.ui-select[multiple], .ui-select[size]:not([size="0"], [size="1"])) .ui-select-icon { display: none; }

  /* iOS Safari zooms the page when a focused field is under 16px */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-select { font-size: 1rem; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Native select** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/native-select/basic.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { NativeSelect } from '@/ui/components/native-select';

export default function NativeSelectBasic() {
  return (
    <Field required className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <Label>Country</Label>
      <NativeSelect defaultValue="" autoComplete="country">
        <option value="" disabled>
          Select a country
        </option>
        <option value="GB">United Kingdom</option>
        <option value="IE">Ireland</option>
        <option value="DE">Germany</option>
        <option value="US">United States</option>
      </NativeSelect>
      <FieldHint>Opens the picker built into your phone or computer.</FieldHint>
    </Field>
  );
}
```
